hooks.text: "The Guild wants to know how deep the Barrows go. Walk down until you'd rather not, then go one more."
"My regulars argue every night about how deep it goes. Settle it, so I can stop hearing about it."
"Before the Watch sends anyone down, it wants to know what it would be sending them into. So, you first."
"They say the Ember's light is stronger the deeper you go. Go and see whether they are right, and come back to tell us."
"I'll sell rope by the yard to whoever goes next. Tell me how many yards."
"Something down there hums. You can feel it through the axle. Find where it's coming from."
